reports.desc: The scammer billed the amount of $13,725 to Medicare using my Medicare number. My Medicare Summary Notice indicated that none of the fraudulent claims were approved and therefore nothing paid out by Medicare. Claims were for 1500 intermittent urinary catheters ordered by a Daniel J Kruse (scammer).
Joy hardester  social security  bank information

They claim to provide real pearls, but after having a jeweller check it, it turned out to be some kind of plastic. I would never pay that kind of money for plastic. The product description is misleading and fake.

I ordered 2 Full size blankets. It was taking a long time with nothing heard from the company   I finally got 2 blankets that were so small, I thought they might be Crib Blankets.  I had two back and forth emails with some named marie who told me to lay the blankets on a bed, measure them and send her a picture. I said no. It was too OBVIOUS that these blankets were too SMALL for a Double/Full size bed. I sent her a copy of her own Fleece Company Ad with measurements of their supposed blankets, AND a statement of “Easy Returns and/or Exchanges” on the ad.  I was asking for an address and instructions on how to return. She would NOT supply that info. As a matter of fact, after sending her a copy of her ad, she stopped communicating with me.
Nothing bundt cake sampler box offer for $9.99.  My bank account was soon hit with 4 debit card transactions for $99+.

Sofyre sent email that order confirmation and shipment out for delivery. Over due 4 days called to check up told product was on the way. When  I asked what the delay was she put me on hold and disconnected.
I called back immediately sounded like the same woman answering, asked same questions and she said Product hasn't shipped yet. When I asked to speak to a manager she hung up.
I order some thca from here and it didn't ever come said delivered but it's not and also paid for express shipping and didn't even get it in two days like they said

I ordered a fireworks squirt gun for my granddaughter. Ordered it in June and never received anything! Contacted the seller multiple times through email and they kept telling me it was in transit. Then when I asked for proof, they said that I received it. Ref refused to give me any money back.

I placed an order with the company by credit card and received notification to track the delivery.  I was advised that delivery was made on 9/7/26.  I was home all day as that was Labor Day and no package arrived.  I have received no response from the company.

Pretended to be an Eddie Bauer website, claiming a big sale. When in checkout, during the payment section, it asked for card info. It claimed the first card entered didn’t work, then on the second card entered the victim realized the website URL was incorrect.  The website clearly was made to steal credit card information.

This person called speaking speak telling me that there were some suspicious Zelle transactions in my account. Then he attempted to read the names like if I knew them. Then he told me that the transaction came from a iPhone 8 and then tried to confirm my information. I didn't give him any information then I told him that I would go in person to bank and he quickly thanked me and hung up

And once again on 14 Sept for the same amount it was pending,  I called my bank and request a new debit card. The last two it stated on my transactions, the city London, and a number 447-454-74460, possible a phone #.  I have no idea who these people are!   But I do know that my personal info was stolen.  I put down my  email, and phone so i can continue.  The last transaction I was credit. will you please look into the matter.  And perhaps inform of the results.
